description: A picture and outline of what is on screen now, NOT recorded. With steps, runs them first, off camera and fast: get the app into the state the next beat starts from, undo what a discarded beat changed, or sign in again ($env: values allowed here). Nothing here becomes footage.

companion.description: Look at (and run the steps in) a companion instead of the app: its name, or true for the first ($env: values allowed in a browser companion, as here for the app)

do.description: Steps to run off camera first

action.description: web/electron: open, click, type, select, hover, scroll, press, drag, upload, wait. terminal: type, press, run, wait_for. ios/android: open, click, type, press, scroll, drag, wait (see demo_start's ios). upload clicks the target (the app's upload button or drop zone) and answers the file picker it opens, on camera, with the file in value

intent.description: What the step does, a few words ("Open the Billing tab")

ms.description: wait: how long; run/wait_for: the most to wait

target.description: How to find an element: prefer role+name, then text, then selector.

name.description: Accessible name (with role) or a form label (alone)

selector.description: CSS selector, last resort. In a demo step, "@x,y" is a point in the window (CSS px; points on a phone) for a canvas with nothing to target

to.description: drag: where to drop, found like target (role and name, text, or a CSS selector: an empty column or list has no text, so give its selector). Instead of value.

name.description: Accessible name (with role) or a form label (alone)

selector.description: CSS selector, last resort. In a demo step, "@x,y" is a point in the window (CSS px; points on a phone) for a canvas with nothing to target

until.description: terminal run: a regex the output must match before the step ends (default: output goes quiet)

value.description: Text to type (clicks the target, then types: an input's text is replaced, a rich editor's goes in at the click; with no target, types into what already has focus without clicking, so a selection the last click made is typed over), option, key (Enter, Tab, Escape, ArrowDown, Control+C), path to open, pixels to scroll, the drop target's text, upload: the file to choose (one you made for the demo and registered with demo_temp_file); terminal: the command to run or the regex to wait for

name: demo_view
title: Look at the app (not recorded)
